description: This is a test class for the RetrieveFeatureStrategy component in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of retrieving features from a 'thing' entity, including cases for existing features, features in entities without features, and non-existing features.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the RetrieveFeatureStrategy, verifying retrieval logic for features within the Eclipse Ditto system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of RetrieveFeatureStrategy before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the RetrieveFeatureStrategy class is immutable.

methods.name: retrieveExistingFeature
methods.description: Tests retrieving an existing feature from a 'thing' with features.

methods.name: retrieveFeatureFromThingWithoutFeatures
methods.description: Tests attempting to retrieve a feature from a 'thing' that has no features, expecting an exception.

methods.name: retrieveNonExistingFeature
methods.description: Tests attempting to retrieve a feature that does not exist in the 'thing', expecting an exception.
